S.FORM: mia kaptaan ku ia ni-meipacei ku ni-papa-ka'ʉʉnʉ ku cau camai mata pa'ici.
S.PHON: mia kaptaan ku ia nimeipaʦei ku nipapakaʔɨɨnɨ ku ʦau ʦamai mata paʔiʦi
S.FORM: mia kaptaan ku ia nimeipacei ku nipapaka'ʉʉnʉ ku cau camai mata pa'ici.

S.TRANSL: When I was the leader, I let the people eat and drink.
I didn't know what to say.
I didn't know what to say.
I thought by myself: "What to do?"
In the sequel I tried to hold the children together.
I wanted to try to make them listen (to me).
